_doc: Capability map for the Jev plugin advisor (jev_router.py advise). 'kind' skill/service are suggested per-prompt (NON-BLOCKING one-liner); 'always-on' are documented only, never suggested. 'when' is the trigger Jev matches the prompt against; 'value_add' is the <=90-char operator-facing one-liner. Services say 'Set up' (they are not per-prompt installs). See directives/infrastructure/claude_plugins.md and directives/infrastructure/jev.md.

agent-reach.when: The prompt pastes or names a social/video/forum link (YouTube, Reddit, X/Twitter, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, GitHub, LinkedIn, V2EX, Instagram) or asks to read, search, scrape, or get subtitles/comments/quotes from one, and the agent's own web tools cannot.
agent-reach.value_add: Pasted a social/video/forum link? agent-reach reads it (posts, comments, subtitles).

lemo-opuscar.when: The prompt asks to explain, visualize, teach, or animate how code, an algorithm, or a data structure works as a video, film, or animation.
lemo-opuscar.value_add: Explaining how code or an algorithm works? lemo-opuscar renders it as a short film.

skill-inspector.when: The prompt is about installing, adding, cloning, enabling, or trusting a downloaded skill or plugin, or asks whether a skill/plugin is safe, over-permissioned, or malicious.
skill-inspector.value_add: Installing a downloaded skill/plugin? skill-inspector scans it for malice first.

freellmapi.when: The prompt mentions hitting LLM rate limits, HTTP 429s, quota or credit exhaustion, model overload, or wanting free or pooled model providers behind one endpoint.
freellmapi.value_add: Hitting model rate limits? Set up FreeLLMAPI to pool free providers behind one endpoint.

pentagi.when: The prompt asks to run an authorized penetration test, vulnerability scan, exploit, or offensive security assessment against a target the operator owns or has written permission to test.
pentagi.value_add: Authorized pentest? Set up PentAGI — your machine, targets you own or have permission for.

ponytail.when: Documented only, never suggested per-prompt: always-on lazy-dev hooks + task band.
ponytail.value_add: Always-on: nudges lazy-dev shortcuts and tracks tasks via hooks; not per-prompt.

safety-guard.when: Documented only, never suggested per-prompt: always-on destructive-bash guard.
safety-guard.value_add: Always-on: rewrites or blocks destructive bash (rm -rf, force-push, DROP).

opencode.when: The prompt wants a second, provider-agnostic terminal coding agent, or to run coding work on OpenRouter, FreeLLMAPI or local models instead of Claude.
opencode.value_add: Want a coding agent on any model? Set up OpenCode (MIT CLI, plan/build agents).

voicestudio.when: The prompt needs text-to-speech, voice cloning, transcription or dubbing done locally without a paid speech API.
voicestudio.value_add: Need TTS, voice cloning or dubbing? Set up VoiceStudio: local API + MCP on :3900.

open-seo.when: The prompt asks for keyword research, rank tracking, backlinks, an SEO site audit or AI-search visibility for a site.
open-seo.value_add: SEO research or audit? Set up OpenSEO (self-hosted; DataForSEO key, pay per use).

openbot.when: The prompt wants persistent AI agents running 24/7 on a server with queues and agent-to-agent messaging, for non-commercial use.
openbot.value_add: 24/7 agents with queues? Set up OpenBot. Noncommercial licence: not for client work.

replica-skill.when: The prompt asks to rebuild, reverse-engineer or rebrand an existing app or SaaS the operator owns or has rights to, as a clean-room build.
replica-skill.value_add: Rebuilding an app you have rights to? Start with /replica-recon <app URL> (installed).
